paragraph: Rockleigh is one of the smallest markets in Bergen County, and the numbers show it. One single-family sale closed in the last six months, at $2,830,000 against a $2,900,000 asking price, a sale-to-list ratio of about 97.6 percent after 30 days on market. That is a single transaction, not a trend, and no honest read of one closing tells you where prices are heading. No condo, co-op, or multi-family activity at all. What you can take from it is the price tier Rockleigh trades in and the fact that a well-positioned house here found its buyer in about a month with only a modest adjustment off list. If you're looking here, plan on a long search with few comparable sales to lean on, and expect to price or negotiate off the broader northern Bergen luxury market rather than off Rockleigh itself.
